rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIniacin
Exhibition name: Perfume Beauty ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by Alain Meilland (1940-....) (France, before 1990).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1991 as 'Fragrant Lady'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1996 as 'Mary Potter'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. Strong fragrance. 36 to 43 petals. Average diameter 5.25". Very large, moderately full, borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Medium buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Semi-glossy, leathery foliage. 3 to 5 leaflets.

Height: 39" to 43" (100 to 110cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
